flood.name: Flood
flood.about: The Ciliwung overflows and streets near the river go under water.

fixes.name: Raise the street above flood level
fixes.what: 275 m of street on the route from a cut-off neighbourhood to its nearest services, made to stay open

fixes.name: Build a raised footbridge
fixes.what: A new 169 m link between two safe streets that the disaster otherwise separates

fixes.name: Run a flood-day clinic shuttle
fixes.what: On the day, a minibus from a safe pickup point to a clinic 463 m away

fire.name: Fire
fire.about: Fires break out in the densest blocks of houses and close every street close to the flames.

fixes.name: Widen the alley into a fire lane
fixes.what: 49 m of street on the route from a cut-off neighbourhood to its nearest services, made to stay open

fixes.name: Open a second way out
fixes.what: A new 213 m link between two safe streets that the disaster otherwise separates

fixes.name: Run an evacuation shuttle to the clinic
fixes.what: On the day, a minibus from a safe pickup point to a clinic 607 m away

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.about: Fallen walls block narrow lanes in dense blocks, and some bridges close for inspection.

fixes.name: Retrofit and widen the street
fixes.what: 9 m of street on the route from a cut-off neighbourhood to its nearest services, made to stay open

fixes.name: Build a new connecting street
fixes.what: A new 212 m link between two safe streets that the disaster otherwise separates

fixes.name: Run a shuttle to the clinic
fixes.what: On the day, a minibus from a safe pickup point to a clinic 371 m away
